feeds.title: TeachHUB
feeds.description: K-12 News, Lessons & Shared ResourcesBy Teachers, For Teachers. It is our mission to improve the quality of education by making available the most recent, complete and affordable tools, resources and opportunities for all K-12 educators.

feeds.title: eSchool News
feeds.description: eSchool News covers education technology in all its aspects, from legislation and litigation, to best practices, to lessons learned and new products. First published in March of 1998, eSchool News is a monthly print and digital newspaper providing the news and information necessary to help K-20 decision-makers successfully use technology and the internet to transform North America's schools and colleges and achieve their educational goals.

feeds.title: Model Teaching
feeds.description: Our mission is to offer high-quality courses that help improve teaching performance. We do this by providing training geared toward implementation in the classroom.

feeds.title: THE Journal » K-12 Education News
feeds.description: THE Journal is dedicated to informing and educating K-12 senior-level district and school administrators, technologists, and tech-savvy educators within districts, schools and classrooms to improve and advance the learning process through the use of technology.

feeds.title: EdTech K 12 Magazine
feeds.description: EdTech Magazine explores K-12 technology and education issues that IT leaders and educators face when they're evaluating and implementing a solution for K-12 and Higher Ed.

feeds.title: The Educator Australia Magazine
feeds.description: The Educator Magazine is Australia's magazine and news website for the most senior educational professionals and decision-makers. The magazine covers stories and high-level case studies providing a global and national perspective on education leadership and management best practices, as well as interviews with the finest minds in education.

feeds.title: Renaissance Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest posts from Renaissance Blog for shareable tips and insightful thoughts on K-12 education. Renaissance is a Global Leader in preK-12 Technology with the mission to accelerate learning for all children and adults of all ability levels and ethnic and social backgrounds, worldwide.

feeds.title: Grant Lichtman Blog
feeds.description: Grant Lichtman is a nationally recognized thought leader in the drive to transform K-12 education. Educator, author, speaker, facilitator, change agent, Chief Provocateur. Helping educators re-imagine and realize the power of great learning.

feeds.title: K-12 Dive
feeds.description: K-12 Dive is a leading publication operated by Industry Dive and provides news and analysis for leaders in k-12 education. We cover topics like classroom tech, policy, school systems, personalized learning, and more. Catch the latest disruptive stories and articles in the Educational sector here. K-12 Dive is a leading publication operated by Industry Dive.

feeds.title: CalMatters » K-12 Education
feeds.description: News and analysis of California's education policies for public, charter & private K-12 schools. Get Updates on California school funding, budgets & more. CalMatters is a nonpartisan and nonprofit news organization bringing Californians stories that probe, explain, and explore solutions to quality-of-life issues while holding our leaders accountable.

feeds.title: K12 Prospects Blog
feeds.description: K12Prospects blog delivers content on new things happening in the education market. Check our weekly posts and other content about selling to schools. K12 Prospects compiles K-12 school data and provides it to companies and small businesses that are in need of school email lists to reach principals, superintendents and other district personnel.

feeds.title: K12 Digest.
feeds.description: K12 Digest is an independent international K12 Education information platform (portal & magazine), covers everything that matters to the leaders and readers of the K12 Education sector worldwide. This feed features selected articles and stories that shed light on the most important issues in the Education sector.

feeds.title: Ask a Tech Teacher
feeds.description: Ask a Tech Teacher is a group of tech ed teachers who work together to offer you tech tips, advice, pedagogic discussion, lesson plans, and anything else they can think of to help you integrate tech into your classroom for education.

feeds.title: District Administration
feeds.description: Find K-12 education news for school district leaders, including the latest developments in edtech, staffing, leadership, analysis and thought leadership. District Administration is the most widely received and read publication for K-12 district-level school leaders nationwide. DA provides cutting-edge coverage of education technology, news, curriculum, policy, finance, profiles and more to this exclusive audience across print, digital and in-person event platforms.

feeds.title: Hot Lunch Tray
feeds.description: Serving up steaming scoops of K12 edtech observation, thoughts, and opinions. With gravy. On HotLunchTray I provide insights on educational technology, teacher professional learning, and fresh opinions on education.

feeds.title: 21st Century Educational Technology and Learning
feeds.description: K12 educational transformation through technology. Interests in topic 21century skills, PBL, STEM, & NETS.

feeds.title: K-12 Legal Insights
feeds.description: K-12 Legal Insights is a legal publication that provides commentary and analysis on a wide variety of education law topics. Blog authors and Husch Blackwell's education attorneys provide commentary for federal grants, ELL and special education programs, school finance, policy development and other related topics.
